changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpreauthorizationattachments AS SELECT paa.id, paa.pre_authorization_id, paa.created_by, paa.space_key, paa.filename, paa.mime_type, paa.size_bytes, paa.created_date, paa.deleted_at, paa.type, paa.details, paa.source, paa.source_id, paa.supporting_info_id, paa.is_sent_to_waseel, paa.waseel_attachment_id, paa.last_modified_by, paa.last_modified_date FROM public.pre_authorization_attachments paa;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpreauthorizationattachments TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpreauthorizationattachments FROM report_user;
